tasks.label: migrate-core
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T core npx --yes node-pg-migrate -m migrations --check-order false -d postgres://$PGUSER:$PGPASSWORD@$PGHOST:$PGPORT/$PGDATABASE up

tasks.label: rebuild-core
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build core; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d core

tasks.label: rebuild-connectivity
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build connectivity; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d connectivity

tasks.label: rebuild-core-and-connectivity
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build core connectivity; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d core connectivity
